cases.expected: No actual page error or external network request in the isolated real WebGL/Floor3D fixture

setup: Real blank Canvas click pauses auto rotation via the existing product handler; callbacks are measured by deltas. Live actor/DOM plaque coordinates are read immediately before each mouse click rather than reused across a screenshot.
method: Actual imported Floor3D/React Three Fiber/Drei/BusinessAvatar3D/cinematic with real browser WebGL and native RAF. Exact original source uses import-path-only rewrite; no layout, target, hitbox, camera or Three model implementation is copied or replaced. Actual rendered HTML/Range bounds, actual GazeRegistry world points projected by the product camera, and actual mouse callback deltas are observed.
limitations: Optional drop delivery uses actual browser-native DataTransfer/DragEvent constructors, synthetically dispatched at the actual elementFromPoint; it is not an OS-native drag gesture. Owned synthetic component payload and desktop Chromium, not native cold startup/real phone/full UX; AudioEngine mute preference and no director event; no model/provider/DB requests.
